label: Create table User
summary: Creates table User with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "User" (
  "email" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("email")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ?1 AND "name" = ?2)

postcheck.description: verify table "User" has exactly its columns
postcheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('User')) = 3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('User') WHERE (name, LOWER(type), "notnull", pk) IN (VALUES ('email', 'text', 1, 0), ('id', 'integer', 1, 1), ('name', 'text', 1, 0))) = 3
